scenario.title: A reset with an unmet prerequisite
scenario.ticket: Jo: My label says Vale L4 USB. My laptop print queue is still processing jobs and the printer is busy. The print quality is poor. Should I reset it right now? Tell me the safe next step. I have not cancelled the pending jobs.

documents.title: L4 USB reset prerequisites
documents.text: The L4 USB connects by the included USB cable. Before a reset, cancel pending laptop print jobs and wait until the printer is idle. Never reset or disconnect power while jobs are processing. Once idle, hold Reset for 3 seconds, then release. A reset clears local preferences; it does not guarantee that print quality will improve.
